name: ApeRocket AutoCake donated-CAKE profit minting
summary: AutoCake valued shares and profit from its whole CAKE balance, so CAKE sent to it became profit for the majority shareholder, and SpaceMinter minted SPACE for the performance fee on that profit at a fixed rate per BNB. The attacker took a majority share with flash-borrowed CAKE, sent more CAKE to the vault, and claimed through getReward and withdrawAll. It sold the minted SPACE into the SPACE-BNB pair.
notes: The anchor is a smaller run of the same deposit, harvest, getReward and withdrawAll sequence, by 0x71b5ea15281135543ae95b356dd9cacc041d1337 through contract 0x32c83e563d47b0ec1a3928660035152255dc9d37. It came 4,111 blocks before the attack Inspex reports (0x701a308f) and drained 13.9 BNB from the SPACE-BNB pair. campaign.mjs found no other third-party pull on AutoCake up to block 9400000.

SpaceMinter (unverified) mints a fixed SPACE amount per BNB of fee. AutoCake could mint only after the owner granted it minter rights in 0xe08c1f74, the latest reset; initialize (0x4e8b7062) set AutoCake's minter pointer before that.

The Polygon attack 0x377fb92f is counted as part of the campaign (rule 4). A different attacker hit ApeRocket's sibling MATIC-DAI LP vault there: it inflated the vault's profit by depositing LP for the vault into ApeSwap's MiniApeV2, then sold the minted pSPACE.

Loss is the BNB that the SPACE-BNB pair 0xd0f82498051067e154d1dcd3d88fa95063949d7e and the pSPACE-WETH pair 0x4e540fad17f1a51380fa2bba7185dbdf4f54a713 paid out for unbacked SPACE and pSPACE, with the minted tokens not subtracted (rule 11). It exceeds the reported 1.26m USD, which is net attacker profit.
